patch.description:
Run as an Operation: the audio stream restarts with the new settings and rolls back to the last working ones when no audio arrives.

A `sample_rate` must be one the device supports, `frames_per_buffer` one of the listed choices.
patch.summary: Change the microphone settings

post.description:
Claims the single stream and returns its id. `409` while another browser streams or when the source is not `browser`.

Then send about 40 ms of 16-bit little-endian mono PCM per request to the chunks endpoint.
A stream that sends nothing for about 5 seconds is released. Nothing resumes by itself: open a new stream.

delete.description: Releases the claim. Closing a stream that is already gone is not an error.

post.description: The body is raw 16-bit little-endian mono PCM, sent as `application/octet-stream`. `410` when the stream expired.

parameters.description: Number of the chunk, counted from 0 for each stream. A gap is filled with silence.

get.description:
What MLSC heard during the last successful test: after the device, sample rate and software gain, before the effects.

Kept in memory only, replaced by the next test and gone on restart. `404` when there is no clip or while a test runs.

post.description:
Watches the live input for two seconds and reports silence, no device or permission denied, with a hint to fix it.

A working microphone also leaves a clip of what it heard, see `/recording`. `409` while another test runs.
